item.title: Texans' Will Anderson cites Scripture, gives shoutout to Jesus after playoff victory
item.description: Houston Texans All-Pro defensive end Will Anderson paraphrased Scripture and gave a shoutout to Jesus Christ after his team secured a sure-handed victory against the Pittsburgh Stealers during the first round of the NFL playoffs on Monday night. #NationalFootballLeague #ESPN #HoustonTexans #WillAnderson

item.title: Chip and Joanna Gaines' company make largest donation ever to Baylor baseball program: 'Lifelong dream'
item.description: The Waco, Texas-based lifestyle company founded by Christian reality TV stars Chip and Joanna Gaines made the largest donation to the baseball program at Baylor University in its history, the school announced earlier this week. #ChipGaines #JoanaGaines #BaylorUniversity #education

item.title: Lecrae says viral Druski megachurch parody reflects real church problems: 'Wolves in the plupit'
item.description: Christian artist Lecrae said his reaction to a viral comedy sketch by comedian Druski mocking megachurch culture was not offense, but recognition, as many real-life churches feature “wolves in the pulpits,” “theatrics for attention and money and influence,” and leaders “manipulating God's name for gains.” #Lecrae #Druski #megachurch #comedyskit

item.title: Riley Gaines warns potential Supreme Court victory won't end battle to protect women's sports
item.description: Female athletes are hopeful the U.S. Supreme Court will side with “common sense” and “truth” by upholding bans on trans-identified male athletes competing in women’s sports. #SupremeCourt #SelinaSoule #RileyGaines #Transgender #Womenssports

item.title: Pastor John-Paul Miller pleads not guilty to cyberstalking wife until her death
item.description: South Carolina Pastor John-Paul Miller who is accused of making false statements to federal investigators and cyberstalking his estranged wife, Mica Miller, for nearly two years until she took her own life in 2024 has pleaded not guilty to the charges in federal court. #MicaMiller #JohnPaulMiller #SouthCarolina #Pastor #Indicted

item.title: Open Doors US releases 2026 World Watch List report: 'Persecution is expanding'
item.description: Nonprofit persecution watchdog group Open Doors US released its annual World Watch List on Wednesday, which ranks the top 50 countries where Christian persecution and discrimination are at a record high. #OpenDoorsUSA #RyanBrown #WorldWatchList #persecution

item.title: Ashley St. Clair's name removed by Brave Books; Elon Musk seeks full custody of son
item.description: Brave Books announced that it will remove Ashley St. Clair's name from all future prints of her 2021 book, "Elephants Are Not Birds," saying she no longer "aligns" with the book's message. Meanwhile, Elon Musk said he will seek full custody of his son, Romulus, over concerns that St. Clair may try to “transition” the 1-year-old child. #ElonMusk #custodybattle #AshleyStClaire #genderidentity #transgenderism

item.title: Rand Paul claims DOJ ignoring Fauci prosecution referrals: 'He shouldn't get away with lying'
item.description: Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., claimed during a Tuesday appearance on "The Joe Rogan Experience" that he has repeatedly issued criminal referrals for Dr. Anthony Fauci over lying to Congress, but that the U.S. Department of Justice has continued to ignore them even under President Donald Trump. #RandPaul #AnthonyFauci #Congress

item.title: Lecrae is no longer worried about pleasing everyone in the room after finding freedom
item.description: Grammy Award-winning Christian hip-hop artist, activist and CEO, Lecrae Moore, popularly known by his first name, is unapologetically free says and he’s no longer worried about pleasing everyone in the room. #Lecrae #SetMeFree #Christian #Book

item.title: Sen. Josh Hawley grills expert Democrat witness on if men can get pregnant: 'Quite depressing'
item.description: Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Mo., faced resistance Wednesday when he asked an obstetrician, who was called by Democrats as an expert witness during a U.S. Senate hearing, if men can get pregnant. #JoshHawley #NishaVerma #Congress #Senate #abortion #transgender
